rationale: Report cards in ModerationDashboard are div onClick, so a keyboard user cannot open a report at all. Needs a real button.
The command input in LessonPage calls preventDefault on every Tab, even with nothing to complete. Same gap as lesson-tab-out in the smoke matrix.
The skip link points at #main-content but the <main> in LoginPage and AuthPageShell has no such id.
Code blocks and preview panes scroll but cannot be focused, so keyboard users cannot scroll them.
The command input is disabled when the lesson is finished, so focus falls back to body. Needs focus moved to the result or the next lesson link.
The app has no focus handling on route change yet, so focus does not move into the new page and nothing is announced.
The user menu button in Navigation has its only text in a hidden lg:inline span, so below lg it has no name.
The trash icon delete buttons in the notes list have no aria-label.
The note title and room id inputs in CollabNotesPage have no label.
The studio content textarea has no label.
The template select in CollabNotesPage has no label.
aria-label does not contain the visible text on the view mode, share and back buttons, which breaks voice control.
The top nav and the other landmarks have no aria-label, so screen readers list identical landmarks.
These pages render their own <main> inside the one from AppLayout.
Same nested <main> as above, one change fixes both.
No h1 on the chat and notes rooms. On /signup the only h1 is in the panel that is hidden below lg.
Card titles skip heading levels. Needs a heading pass over the dashboard widgets and the lesson panels.
SessionTracker renders outside every landmark on desktop.
The skip link has no target here (see keyboard/skip-link), so axe counts it as content outside a landmark.
The confetti overlay from NotificationProvider is a fixed div outside every landmark while it plays.
The Timer icon in SessionTracker and the Sparkles icons in CollabNotesPage and ContentStudioPage pulse forever and ignore prefers-reduced-motion.
The background blobs in AuthPageShell pulse forever and ignore prefers-reduced-motion.
The success message in LessonPage keeps bouncing and ignores prefers-reduced-motion.
The Trophy icon in StatsCards bounces forever and the live badge in AdminDashboard pulses forever.
